title: Golden Egg
description:
When thrown a Golden Chicken is spawned where the egg lands. Golden Chickens lay gold ingots when they are fed gold ore: drop a gold ore item next to the chicken and it will eat it, and 30 to 60 seconds later it lays 3 gold ingots. It needs another gold ore for every batch. Golden Chickens cannot breed.

A Golden Egg cannot be crafted. There is one inside of every Bean Pod (on top of a grown Magic Bean), unless the pod is destroyed by an explosion, which only gives a chance of it. This can be turned off in the config.

properties.label: Config
properties.value: GoldenEgg (default true): whether Bean Pods drop a Golden Egg

properties.label: Chicken output
properties.value: 3 gold ingots per gold ore eaten, after 30 to 60 seconds
